title: Design: New Credit Term window with Net days looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Note today's date on the calendar of the location you work in (date A).
  • Work out date B: the date 14 days later.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p3-01-new-credit-term-net-x-days.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "Net 14 Days" in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A window titled "New Credit Term" opens with a close × at the right.

Step 2:

  • Name reads "Net 14 Days".

Step 3:

  • The window matches ct-p3-01-new-credit-term-net-x-days.png: the Name box with its floating label and the grey hint "Up to 31 characters. Prints on invoices and goes to QuickBooks." under it.
  • Below, two rows with round option buttons: "Due Net X days" (chosen) with the Days box and "days after the invoice date" after it, and "Due day of the following month" with a greyed, empty Day box and pale "of the following month"
  • Under them a light-blue box with an info icon and blue text "Net 14 Days means payment is due 14 days after the invoice date. An invoice dated date A is due date B."
  • At the bottom right "Cancel" (white) and "Create Credit Term" (blue).
  • The Cancel style: this attribute depends on question 12 (drawn pictures or build pictures, not answered yet): for now compare it with the picture named here.

Step 4:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

The two dates show as a short month and day.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R1: “"New Credit Term" opens a window titled "New Credit Term"; Edit opens the same window titled "Edit Credit Term". The buttons are "Cancel" and "Create Credit Term" (New) or "Save Changes" (Edit).”
  • S3-R2: “The window holds:”
  • S3-R2, Name: “Name (required), focused on open, accepting at most 31 characters, with the hint "Up to 31 characters. Prints on invoices and goes to QuickBooks."”
  • S3-R2, the two options: “Two options, one chosen at a time: "Due Net X days" with a Days box followed by "days after the invoice date", and "Due day of the following month" with a Day box followed by "of the following month".”
  • S3-R3: “A new term opens on "Due Net X days" with both boxes empty and the Day box disabled. Only the chosen option's box is active; the other is disabled and empty.”
  • S3-R5: “While the chosen box holds a valid number, a blue information line below the options explains the term, using today's date as the example invoice date (S3-R16):”
  • S3-R5, Net line: “Net: "{Name} means payment is due {X} days after the invoice date. An invoice dated {today} is due {due}." For example: "Net 14 Days means payment is due 14 days after the invoice date. An invoice dated Oct 21 is due Nov 4."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Name field hint | "Up to 31 characters. Prints on invoices and goes to QuickBooks." | Hint under the field, always shown”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Valid Net term typed | "{Name} means payment is due {X} days after the invoice date. An invoice dated {today} is due {due}." | Blue information line, updates as the user types”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" ("New credit term: Net X days"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p3-01-new-credit-term-net-x-days.png

The design's own words:

  • “New Credit Term opens this window. Two kinds only: "Due Net X days" (1 to 365) or "Due day of the following month" (1 to 31). No separate Due label above them. The Name field opens without any error.”
  • “Only the selected option's box is active (Days, with 14). The other option's box is greyed out (DS disabled field) and empty. Clicking a greyed box selects its option; switching clears the box you left.”
  • “Source: DS Modals (form body), DS Text field, DS Radio, DS Alert (info).”
